title: Choose the Options composition
question: Same F8 night-ink world. All six tabs and every stock control stay. Pick how Options sits on the studio.

options.label: Pit bottom tabs
options.thesis: A floating night-ink form board owns the stage; the six tabs live as a modern bottom chrome strip with Back and a skew Done — instrument-dense rows, not a flat settings sheet.
options.viewport: Grey studio. Large inset form board. Graphics pane dense. Bottom: six tabs with Graphics orange pip, Back left, Done skew right.
options.risk: Tabs fight Done for the bottom edge if the strip is too tight.

raised.raise: Rows read as a signal bench: tighter label/value columns, detented spin/slider chrome, active tab locks like a triggered channel.

options.label: Left category rail
options.thesis: Options borrows the main dest card: a left night-ink rail of the six categories with orange pip; the active pane is a separate floating form board on the right.
options.viewport: Studio peeks. Left rail lists Input…Simulation; Graphics selected. Right board holds the Graphics form. Back and Done on the form board.
options.risk: Two plaques can feel heavier than main’s single dest card.

options.label: Segment + sheet
options.thesis: Server grammar: a single inset board with a Local/World-style segment row for the six categories, then the form sheet under it — Join’s cousin is Done.
options.viewport: Inset board on studio. Top segment strip of six categories; Graphics on. Dense form below. Back and Done on the board chrome.
options.risk: Six segments can crowd; labels may truncate.
